title: Jupiter API Machine Context Prompt
description: A comprehensive schema for Jupiter APIs to be used as a Machine Context Prompt (MCP) for AI tools like Claude

swap.description: Jupiter Swap API allows developers to access liquidity on Solana. It returns serialized transactions needed to execute swaps.

quote.description: Get the best priced quote for a swap between two tokens

inputMint.description: The mint address of the input token (e.g., So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112 for SOL)

outputMint.description: The mint address of the output token (e.g., EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v for USDC)

amount.description: The amount of input tokens to swap in raw units (e.g., lamports for SOL, where 1 SOL = 1,000,000,000 lamports)

slippageBps.description: The maximum slippage tolerance in basis points (e.g., 50 for 0.5%)

onlyDirectRoutes.description: If true, only direct routes between the input and output tokens will be considered

restrictIntermediateTokens.description: If true, only use highly liquid tokens as intermediate hops

excludeDexes.description: Comma-separated list of DEX names to exclude from routing

maxAccounts.description: Maximum number of accounts to include in the transaction (helpful for composability)

asLegacyTransaction.description: If true, returns a legacy transaction instead of a versioned transaction

platformFeeBps.description: Fee in basis points to be charged by the platform integrating Jupiter

swap.description: Get a serialized transaction for the swap based on a quote

quoteResponse.description: The quote response object from the /quote endpoint

userPublicKey.description: The public key of the user performing the swap

wrapAndUnwrapSol.description: If true, automatically wrap and unwrap SOL as needed

feeAccount.description: The account to receive platform fees (if platformFeeBps was specified in the quote)

dynamicComputeUnitLimit.description: If true, dynamically adjust compute unit limit based on transaction complexity

prioritizationFeeLamports.description: Custom priority fee settings for the transaction

dynamicSlippage.description: Dynamic slippage settings for optimizing execution

swap-instructions.description: Get individual instructions for the swap instead of a complete transaction

quoteResponse.description: The quote response object from the /quote endpoint

userPublicKey.description: The public key of the user performing the swap

useTokenLedger.description: If true, use token ledger for dynamic input amounts

program-id-to-label.description: Get a mapping of program IDs to their corresponding DEX labels

token.description: Jupiter Token API provides access to token information, verification status, and safety checks
Get detailed information about a specific token

mint.description: The mint address of the token

market.description: Get token mints that belong to a specific market/pool

tradable.description: Get all token mints that are tradable on Jupiter

tagged.description: Get tokens with a specific tag

tag.description: Tag to filter tokens by (e.g., verified, lst, token-2022)

new.description: Get new tokens sorted by creation timestamp

all.description: Get all tokens indexed by Jupiter (large response)

shield.description: Jupiter Shield API provides token safety information and warnings
Get safety information and warnings for specified token mints

mints.description: Comma-separated list of token mint addresses

warningTypes.NOT_VERIFIED: Token is not verified by Jupiter
warningTypes.LOW_ORGANIC_ACTIVITY: Token has low organic trading activity
warningTypes.HAS_FREEZE_AUTHORITY: Token has a freeze authority that can prevent trading
warningTypes.HAS_MINT_AUTHORITY: Token has a mint authority that can create new tokens
warningTypes.HAS_PERMANENT_DELEGATE: Token has a permanent delegate authority
warningTypes.BLACKLISTED: Token is blacklisted due to security concerns
warningTypes.HONEYPOT: Token may be a honeypot scam

price.description: Jupiter Price API provides price information for tokens
Get price information for specified tokens

ids.description: Comma-separated list of token mint addresses

swapWorkflow.description: Standard workflow for executing a swap
steps: 1. Get a quote using the /quote endpoint with input/output tokens and amount
2. Obtain a serialized transaction using the /swap endpoint with the quote response
3. Deserialize, sign, and submit the transaction to the Solana blockchain

example.description: Example of swapping SOL to USDC

tokenSafety.description: Pattern for checking token safety before trading
steps: 1. Get token information using the Token API
2. Check for verification status using the 'verified' tag
3. Get safety warnings using the Shield API
4. Analyze warnings and present to users before trading

errorHandling.description: Best practices for handling errors from Jupiter APIs
recommendations: Always check for error responses and handle them gracefully
Implement retries with exponential backoff for transient errors
Parse error messages to provide meaningful feedback to users
Handle network congestion scenarios with appropriate retry strategies

transactionSubmission.description: Best practices for submitting transactions to Solana
recommendations: Use skipPreflight=true to avoid client-side simulation failures
Set appropriate priority fees for faster transaction confirmation
Implement proper error handling for transaction failures
Consider using dynamic compute unit limits for complex transactions

userExperience.description: Best practices for user experience when integrating Jupiter
recommendations: Always show token verification status to users
Display price impact and slippage information clearly
Provide transaction confirmation status and links to explorers
Implement proper loading states during API calls and transaction processing

possibleCauses: Amount too small or too large
solutions: Exclude problematic DEXes using excludeDexes parameter
Ensure sufficient funds for the swap and fees
Implement retry mechanism with fresh quotes
Use Shield API to avoid problematic tokens
